skill_name: Summarize the article in less than 100 words by retaining the main ideas.
workflow: The Ebola virus is a deadly virus with a high fatality rate of up to 90%. It was first discovered in 1976 in regions of Central and West Africa, and over the years has caused multiple outbreaks. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, symptoms of Ebola include fever, headache, fatigue, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, rash, and bleeding. If left untreated, it can be fatal.
